member.name: T:LakskongenSim.Market.MarketSimulation
member.summary:
Realistic salmon market price simulation based on Norwegian industry dynamics. Models: seasonal patterns, calibrated Ornstein-Uhlenbeck mean reversion, supply/demand shocks, historical Norwegian Fish Pool anchors, quality premiums, multiple sales channels, and market intelligence.
O-U parameters calibrated to Fish Pool FPI data 2020-2025: - Long-term mean ~85 NOK/kg (2020-2025 average; 2023-2025 elevated to ~90-100) - Annual kappa ~0.6-0.8 (moderate mean reversion) - Weekly sigma ~8-12 NOK/kg (high volatility typical of salmon spot) - Price range: NOK 40-160/kg historically
